name: DICOM CT Projection Loading and Geometry Extraction
aliases: CT Projection Geometry Extraction & Coordinate Conversion
definition: Loads CT projection data from Mayo Clinic DICOM files, extracts scanner geometry parameters, applies HU calibration, and constructs a ConeBeamGeometry object.
summary: DICOM CT Projection Loading and Geometry Extraction loads raw CT data, calibrates Hounsfield Units, and constructs ConeBeamGeometry objects by correcting for non-standard metadata and converting cylindrical detector coordinates to rectangular ray paths.
